newsitem.title: THAILAND: Loxley gives loan to Thai Telephone.
newsitem.headline: Loxley gives loan to Thai Telephone.

text.p: Loxley Plc said on Friday it would grant a 875 million baht ($35 million) loan in subordinated debentures to Thai Telephone and Telecommunication Plc.
The company said in a statement to the Stock Exchange of Thailand the decision to grant the loan was made during the company's board meeting on Thursday.
It said the loan would be used as working capital by Thai Telephone and Telecommunication.
Thai Telephone and Telecommunication said on Thursday it would issue 625 million new shares to raise six billion baht to support new diversification projects.
